core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khalimat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Forbearing”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khalimat corresponds to the Arabic form خَلِيمَة (Arabic root ح ل م (ḥ-l-m); حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma)). Its core sense is khalimat; halima (caucasian form). Khalimat is the Caucasian form of Arabic حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma), meaning 'forbearing'.
